what: ARB3's unregistered timing of the joint decision (2026-10-19): sets_cas.json's eight sets under new names (srt-cas-* -> arb3-cas-*), so that speed_rt/sets.py's rule gives new seeds from the stage-1 beacon record: TAG 'convlines speed-rt arb3-cas-<...>'. Chunk j of a set replaces chunk j of seed kind 12 as in sets_cas.json. Used through SRT_SETS_FILE.
